THE GEOGRAPHY BEHIND THE VIEW

Many beginnings,
connected journeys.

Tributaries usually converge downstream. Distributaries split away, particularly in deltas. India’s rivers do not share one source.

The camera tour illustrates geography. It does not model water speed, discharge, floods or real travel time. Chapter holds provide time to read; the timeline measures the presentation, not the water.
